rows.claim: The gateway needs another restart after etcd is restored, since the timeout will then be set.
rows.evidence: No tool output shows the gateway needs a second restart after etcd recovers. The runbook says most services need `opsctl restart <service>` to pick up config, which suggests it, but it says "most", not all. Nothing shows how the gateway behaves, so this is an inference rather than something a tool output confirms.
